title: Equation of a Line
opener_concept: A taxi charges £3 to get in, then £2 per mile. A 0-mile ride still costs £3 (the y-intercept c=3), each mile adds £2 (the gradient m=2), so cost = 2x + 3. Names start-cost/rate as intercept/gradient before any algebra.
